title: Kolo
subtitle: We are constantly working to make your Norwegian language learning more productive.

footer.title: This is only the beginning
footer.subtitle: We have big plans for 2026: story integration, group challenges and even more new content.

changes: The app is now installable (PWA) — runs like a real app on your phone or computer, no browser address bar, fullscreen, and updates itself automatically on every new release

Three new game modes for faster, more engaging review — Speed Round (race the clock with a streak score multiplier), Survival (three lives, one mistake ends the run) and Match (pair up words with translations against the clock)
Upload a profile photo straight from your device instead of pasting a link — the image is automatically compressed before upload so it doesn't waste storage
Username (@handle) is now a required, unique part of every profile — every account has a unique identifier, laying the foundation for upcoming friends and social features
Major mobile redesign of the Profile, Other, and Home pages — noticeably more compact, no more oversized cards or wasted padding
The activity calendar on your profile now adapts to the available width and always shows full Monday-to-Sunday weeks with day labels
Achievements on your profile now collapse into a compact preview of your most recent unlocks instead of a screen filled with dozens of cards
Fixed a visual bug where flipping a flashcard on mobile made the front and back text overlap
Content no longer hides behind the mobile browser's toolbar — fixed viewport-height handling across the whole app
Removed unnecessary entrance animations on frequently visited pages — the interface now responds instantly
The "My Words" / "Kolo Sets" tab switcher on the collections page is now full-width on mobile — words on the left, sets on the right

Fixed a batch of accumulated bugs: collections no longer disappear when deleting a folder, the streak celebration animation now reliably fires, the daily word game no longer gets confused across timezones, email addresses are no longer exposed on the public leaderboard, and daily reminders now correctly reschedule for the next day
New user onboarding — 6-step interactive tutorial modal with animated UI previews auto-launches on first visit; can be restarted anytime from Profile settings
Streak celebration animation — full-screen epic effect with 42 spark particles, shockwave rings, and a giant animated streak counter fires every time a study day is extended
Fixed a bug where completing a study session did not credit the day toward the streak counter
Full Norwegian (Bokmål) 🇳🇴 and Ukrainian 🇺🇦 interface localization — all pages, quiz, flashcards, settings, and 130+ learning tips are now fully translated
Global design refinement across all screens — tighter spacing, cleaner typography, and improved visual hierarchy
Updated collection card layout for better readability and faster interaction
Navigation and layout polish across main and profile views
Major navigation restructuring: the Words section is now a separate management center for your vocabulary, making room for a new interactive Dashboard panel
Launch of the updated Home page — it's now your personal hub with key statistics, useful widgets, and quick access to progress
The Words library now includes exclusive word collections, segmented by proficiency levels (from Beginner to Advanced) with regular content updates
Global update of the design code and interface to achieve impeccable visual clarity and modern user experience

During routine monitoring, a potential vulnerability in the configuration of API interfaces was identified. To ensure user data security and prevent unauthorized access, the hosting provider's protection algorithms initiated an emergency freeze of the server core. We conducted a full audit of security protocols, after which system operation was restored to normal mode
